Bulletproof is a real estate marketing company that works to get you found by home sellers searching Google and AI search engines. Bulletproof combines SEO, Google Business Profile optimization and AI-search visibility, then aims to turn that visibility into calls from sellers.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Bulletproof charges $399–$3,999/month on a fixed 12-month contract that auto-renews. Their stack runs on GoHighLevel, and Bulletproof itself puts the first AI recommendation at about 60 days. They have a thin Trustpilot profile (3.8, 2 reviews) and are not BBB accredited.
